paragraphs.text: Day 7 · Breakfast and transfer to the airport for your flight to Pereira (not included). Welcome at Matecaña International Airport and drive to Santa Rosa de Cabal. At a coffee farm, a local expert guides you through specialty coffee plantations, explaining the whole process from planting and selective hand-picking to pulping; roast beans on a wood stove in a traditional farmhouse kitchen, enjoy the views from bamboo viewpoints, see the drying process and the mill, and finish with a refreshing coffee lemonade. Typical lunch included (4 hours). Optional: a hot-air balloon flight, USD 1,400 for up to 3 people.
